data.title: Representative ID & Authority Docs
data.description: Identification and authorization documents for individuals acting on behalf of the company.

requestedDocuments.description: High-quality color scan of the valid passport biodata page.
Copy of the national identity card (front and back).
Legal document or board resolution authorizing the representation.
Recent utility bill or bank statement showing current residential address.

data.title: Enhanced Representative Verification
data.description: Extended set for representatives of complex or high-risk entities requiring deep identity checks.

requestedDocuments.description: High-quality color scan of the valid passport biodata page.
Any government-issued ID other than passport (driving license, national ID, etc.).
Two recent documents (utility bill + bank statement) confirming residential address, issued within 3 months.
Standard authorized signatory declaration form to be completed and notarized.
Self-declaration form confirming Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status and sanctions screening.
Any prior KYC documents from other regulated institutions (optional, aids due diligence).

data.title: Corporate Representative Docs
data.description: Documents for a corporate body acting as representative, rather than an individual.

requestedDocuments.description: Incorporation certificate of the corporate representative entity.
Resolution from the represented entity's board appointing the corporate representative.
Passport copies and proof of residence of the individuals who will act on behalf of the corporate rep.
Signed legal agreement between the company and its corporate representative.
